text:
Response B is better. Both state the release facts accurately, but Response A has two problems. First, it runs well past the 120-word limit, padded with an opening line about "taking the time to review" and a closing sentence. Second, its closing claim that "no action is required from the team" is an inference the original never makes, which is exactly the kind of unsupported statement a manager might act on. Response B stays under 120 words, covers every feature, improvement, fix and accessibility change, and is accurate throughout. It drops minor details such as the Settings path and the unsubscribe option, but a busy manager doesn't need those.

Verdict: B
